caption:
O you who have believed, fulfill [all] contracts.

Qur’an 5:1 (Surah Al-Maa’idah, opening clause). Day 1 of our series: what Islam says about promises, covenants and pledges.

Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish. Sources on the final frame.

#Quran #Promises #FulfilYourWord #IslamicReminder #Deen
theme: n/a (edited Dola AI footage, watermark cropped out, slowed and boomeranged to 19.8s, original audio removed)

sourcing.primary_text: Qur’an 5:1, Surah Al-Maa’idah. Reel quotes only the OPENING CLAUSE (the instruction to fulfil contracts), labelled on-frame as ‘Opening clause’; the rest of the verse concerns permitted livestock and ihram.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/5:1/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes. Fetched 3 times independently on 2026-10-13 (device build script twice, diffed identical; cloud render script once; sha1 of all editions identical to the device copy).
sourcing.excerpt_method: Each non-Arabic clause is asserted programmatically to be a verbatim prefix of the live edition text. Arabic clause is token 5 up to the first waqf mark U+06DA of the live text; nothing typed from memory.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: API prepends the basmalah to the Uthmani text of the first ayah of a surah; it is not part of 5:1 and was removed (documented). No double spaces, space-before-punctuation, trailing whitespace or control chars in any edition.
sourcing.translators: en Saheeh International, zh Ma Jian, ms Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih, th King Fahad Quran Complex, es Julio Cortes; ko and ja translator listed Unknown by source and labelled as such on-frame.
